body.theme: Evidence-driven worker & router design (not arbitrary debt)
body.text: Reading slots.py, tier.py, split.py, diagnose.py, and ledger.py shows each module solved a concrete empirical failure: Cloudflare's undocumented rolling 24h neuron window, free-model 429s, oversized build items, and control failures. The real issues are surgical bugs inside those modules (code_job.py returning 'pr' on empty edits and failing open on non-'reject' verdicts; slots.py mutating os.environ and missing EST_MILLI_USD entries).

body.theme: P5b and P28 validate Exagium's core anti-gaming thesis
body.text: P5b confirmed dev-set winner's curse on held-out data (top-5 dropped 0.005 more than baselines), while P28 exposed a 37.5-point SWE-bench Verified vs fresh SWE-rebench contamination gap and caught 4/12 unusable dataset tasks before running any agent. Adding a Pareto cost gate to judge.py directly aligns P5 with those findings.

The core bwrap + timer.c + scale.py pipeline remains strong, with two documented boundary improvements remaining (confine-mode rlimits in jail.py and an allowlist in seccomp_filter.h) alongside minor cleanup in queue_ops.py and grade_canary3.py.
